title: Structure and mechanical properties of B2 ordered refractory AlNbTiVZrx (x = 0–1.5) high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by arc melting of the elements in a low-pressure, high-purity argon atmosphere inside a water-cooled copper cavity. The produced ingots were annealed at 1200 °C for 24 h.
